import bpy, os, json, pathlib, subprocess, math
expected=os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(r'C:\mcp-blender\salvador_lacerda_do_zero.blend'))
if os.path.normcase(os.path.normpath(bpy.data.filepath))!=expected: raise RuntimeError(f'ABORTADO arquivo errado {bpy.data.filepath!r}')
up=bpy.data.objects.get('V4 | porta entrada placeholder'); low=bpy.data.objects.get('V4 | CB | porta entrada'); tower=next((o for o in bpy.data.collections['01 WORLD | ELEVADOR LACERDA | blockout v4'].objects if 'torre documental' in o.name.lower()),None)
if not up or not low or not tower: raise RuntimeError('anchors ausentes')
queries=[{'label':'UP','x':float(up.location.x),'y':float(up.location.y),'target':59.45},{'label':'LOW','x':float(low.location.x),'y':float(low.location.y),'target':4.0}]
axis=(up.location.xy-tower.location.xy); axis.normalize()
print('AXIS_TOWER_TO_UP',round(axis.x,6),round(axis.y,6))
work=pathlib.Path(r'C:\mcp-blender\.geo-work'); py=r'C:\mcp-blender\.venv-geo\Scripts\python.exe'; script=work/'find_landing_xy.py'
script.write_text(r'''
import numpy as np,json,sys,math
d=np.load(r'C:\mcp-blender\.geo-work\terrain_2017_candidate.npz'); p=d['verts'].reshape(-1,3); qs=json.loads(sys.argv[1]); ax=np.array(json.loads(sys.argv[2]),float); ax=ax/np.linalg.norm(ax); ay=np.array([-ax[1],ax[0]])
for q in qs:
 dx=p[:,0]-q['x']; dy=p[:,1]-q['y']; dist=np.hypot(dx,dy); dz=np.abs(p[:,2]-q['target']);
 for tol in (0.25,0.5,1.0):
  m=(dz<=tol)&(dist<=120); idx=np.where(m)[0]
  if len(idx):
   j=idx[np.argmin(dist[idx])]; v=np.array([dx[j],dy[j]]); print(q['label'],'TOL',tol,'DIST',round(float(dist[j]),3),'FROM',round(q['x'],3),round(q['y'],3),'TO',round(float(p[j,0]),3),round(float(p[j,1]),3),'Z',round(float(p[j,2]),3),'ALONG_AXIS',round(float(v@ax),3),'CROSS_AXIS',round(float(v@ay),3)); break
 # also report closest objective balancing xy and z, for context
 score=dist+4*dz; m=dist<=120; ii=np.where(m)[0]; j=ii[np.argmin(score[ii])]; v=np.array([dx[j],dy[j]]); print(q['label'],'BALANCED DIST',round(float(dist[j]),3),'Z',round(float(p[j,2]),3),'DZ',round(float(p[j,2]-q['target']),3),'ALONG_AXIS',round(float(v@ax),3),'CROSS_AXIS',round(float(v@ay),3))
''',encoding='utf-8')
r=subprocess.run([py,str(script),json.dumps(queries),json.dumps([axis.x,axis.y])],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=30)
print(r.stdout); print(r.stderr)
if r.returncode: raise RuntimeError('falha buscando landing XY')
print('LANDING_XY_SEARCH_OK')
